# Tom Devonshire

> Software engineer based in Auckland, New Zealand. BE(Hons) Software Engineering,
> First Class Honours, University of Auckland. Full-stack work across C#/ASP.NET,
> React, React Native, Java/Spring Boot and Node/Express.

## Current role
- Junior Developer, Hoist NZ (05/2026 - present). C#, ASP.NET, React, React Native.

## Previous experience
- Software Engineering Intern, Svasthya NZ (01/2025 - 10/2025). Built and deployed a
  cross-platform Point of Sale app in React Native with a Node/Express and MySQL backend,
  integrating Stripe's Terminal SDK to replace a third-party solution and cut transaction
  fees by 28%.
- Undergraduate Software Trainee, New Zealand Physics and Math Competition (01/2024 - 01/2025).
  Full-stack competition platform; migrated the backend from Node/Express to Spring Boot.
- Production and Manufacturing Engineering Intern, Steel & Tube (11/2023 - 03/2024).
  SCORM-compliant e-learning module reporting to the Intelex training platform.

## Projects
- Figaro, a spatial visualisation testing framework (2025). Procedural question generation
  in FreeCAD; evaluated 15,840 responses across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Mistral models
  with shuffled answer positions; analysed in R and benchmarked against 988 students.
- Path.io (2023). Gamified fitness Android app; third place and Most Promising Concept
  at the DEVS x GDSC hackathon.

## Education
